name: pelayomendez-skills
description: Pelayo Méndez's agent instructions and skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: pelayo-skills
plugins.description: On-the-loop operations for coding agents: the agents are the machines, these skills run the line around them. Plan the work (backlog), hand it out (delegate), check it (verify-claim), watch it (watch), hand over (handoff), keep permissions in a charter and the setup tuned. Small units, chained into flows.
